You're here. Have you been well? I'm glad you seem unharmed.
strings.레비 님도 건강해 보이네요. 이곳에 계신 걸 보니 그 적의 흔적을 찾아내: You look well too, Levi. Since you're here, did you find traces of the enemy?
strings.네, 그렇습니다. 잠깐 이쪽으로 오시지요. 조용히 말씀드려야 할 것 같습: Yes. Please come this way. We should speak quietly.
The people we believe are connected to the magic stones are hiding somewhere in Riveria.
strings.그러면 간단하게 설명을 드려야겠네요. 리베라는 프레이오스 대륙의 최대의: Let me give you a brief explanation. Riveria is the largest trading city on Freios.
strings.다른 도시나 마을처럼 귀족과 왕이 아닌 시민들에 의해 운영됩니다. 시의회: Unlike other cities and towns, it is governed by citizens rather than nobles or a king. They form a city council and elect a mayor to lead them.
strings.그 때문인지 도시의 분위기가 다른 곳에 비해 자유롭습니다. 건물이나 도로: Perhaps that's why the atmosphere is freer than elsewhere. The buildings and roads are laid out freely too, and people from many regions come and go.
strings.그러면 외지인에게도 익숙하겠네요. 그러면 제가 뭘 하면 될까요?: Then they must be used to outsiders. What should I do?
Hmm... There will be much to do, so we'll need to make various preparations.
strings.지금 리베라의 상태가 복잡해서 앞으로 해야 할 일도 엄청난 것들이 많을: Riveria's current situation is complicated. Many substantial tasks lie ahead.
strings.준비가 된다면 다시 말을 걸어주셨으면 합니다. 아, 그동안 저도 밀린: Please speak to me again when you're ready. I'll catch up on my own work in the meantime.
strings.준비가 되셨군요. 그럼 말씀드리죠. 용제성에서 발견된 아가슈라의 흔적이: You're ready. Then I'll explain. The trail of the Agasura discovered at the Dragon Emperor's Palace leads through Drulridge in Mirgandia and on to Riveria.
strings.저희가 조사한 바로는 리베라와 가까운 메린 섬에서 그들의 흔적이 발견됐습: Our investigation found traces of them on Merin Island, near Riveria.
An island? Then we should go there at once.
We can't act rashly right now.
strings.먼저 리베라 시청에서 섬 출입을 금지하고 있습니다. 내전 중이라 허가를: First, Riveria's city hall has prohibited entry to the island. They say they can't issue permits during the civil conflict, but it's highly suspicious.
strings.분명 그 안에서 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는데, 막고 있는 것 같다고 해야하: Something is clearly happening inside, and it feels as though they're trying to keep us from seeing it...
strings.그래서 고민 끝에 도와줄 분을 찾았습니다. 리베라에는 시장에게 반기를 들: After careful thought, I found people who can help. Many people in Riveria oppose the mayor.
strings.모험가님께서는 모르겠지만 '혁명군'이라는 이름으로 활동을 하고 있는 분들: You may not know of them, but they're active under the name Revolutionary Army.
What? That sounds strange. A revolutionary army...?
strings.혁명군에서도 이를 의심하고 있습니다. 심상치 않은 생물들의 흔적이 있는: They're suspicious of this too. They say it makes no sense for city hall to control access to an island where unusual creatures have been sighted.
strings.불필요한 사고를 방지하고자 그랬다고 하는데, 여러모로 의심할 수밖에 없는: The officials claim it's to prevent unnecessary accidents, but there are many reasons for suspicion.
So we've decided to cooperate with the revolutionaries who rose against Mayor Zekal's tyranny.
strings.혹시나 드리는 말씀이지만, 이 일은 지엔디아 폐하께서 제게 일임하신 일이: Just so you know, Her Majesty of Jiendia has entrusted this matter to me, so you needn't worry too much.
strings.그런가요? 그러면 리베라 시청에 반기를 든 혁명군과 일을 진행하면 되겠군: I see. Then we should work with the revolutionaries opposing Riveria's city hall.
strings.후우, 생각만 해도 복잡합니다. 아가슈라와 섬, 그리고 리베라 시청의 제: Sigh. It's complicated even to think about. The Agasura, the island, and Zekal at city hall all seem connected.
strings.어쩌면 제칼을 호위하는 정규군을 상대해야 될지도 모르겠지만…. 일단 그건: We may even have to fight the regular troops guarding Zekal... but let's leave that for later.
strings.먼저 로지아라는 분을 찾아가 이야기를 들어주시기 바랍니다. 그분도 혁명군: First, find someone named Rosia and hear what she has to say. She's a member of the Revolutionary Army too...
I've already told her about you, so she'll help you right away.
strings.당신은? 아, 지엔디아 제국의 조사관께서 말씀하신 모험가군요. 자유를 위: Who are you? Ah, the adventurer the Jiendia imperial investigator mentioned. Welcome to Riveria, the city that strives for freedom.
Since we've agreed to cooperate for our respective causes, I should explain things to you too.
You've been asked to investigate Merin Island.
strings.네. 거기에 가려고 하는데, 어떻게 하면 될까요?: Yes. I'd like to go there. How should I proceed?
Leave right away. We've made arrangements so you can get there.
strings.일단 섬에 들어가시는 대로 알비스라는 남자를 찾으세요. 제가 드리는 이: Once you're on the island, find a man named Alvis. Give him this document and explain the situation. He'll help you.
strings.지금 이곳에 오고 있는 정보들은 전부 그곳에 있던 알비스가 제공한 것이니: All the information we're receiving has come from Alvis, who has been stationed there.
strings.넌 누구냐? 혁명군의 증표?: Who are you? A token of the Revolutionary Army?
They said they were sending someone to investigate the island. So it's you.
strings.그런 일이 있었군. 네가 만났던 이상한 생물들이 여기에도 있어. 트윈 헤: So that's what happened. The strange creatures you encountered are here too. Twin-headed ogres, dragons of fire and ice, armored boars...
Creatures like those don't normally live here.
strings.특이한 녀석들이라 확실히 기억하고 있어. 무슨 일 때문에 나타났는지는 알: They're unusual enough that I remember them clearly. I don't know why they appeared...
But when they showed up, the local creatures certainly suffered. I watched quietly from hiding, and something felt wrong.
strings.어느 순간 갑자기 조용해졌다 싶어서 어디로 사라졌나 했더니 드룰리지 근처: Then everything suddenly went quiet. I wondered where they'd disappeared to. So they went all the way to Drulridge.
That means there must be somewhere nearby where those creatures could be staying...
strings.혹시 의심되는 장소를 아시나요?: Do you know any suspicious places?
strings.의심되는 곳이 몇 있어. 하지만, 확실하게 단정할 수는 없었어. 인간을: A few. But I couldn't confirm anything. Plenty of creatures here hate humans and keep getting in my way, so investigating is difficult.
I'd like you to drive some of them off for now...
strings.어때, 해보겠어?: What do you say? Will you try?
Excellent. You're a skilled adventurer. Better than I expected. I like that.
strings.그렇다고 해서 쉽게 생각하지 마. 아직도 많은 적들이 남아있으니까 체력을: But don't take things lightly. Plenty of enemies remain, so conserve your strength.
strings.일단 네가 녀석들의 이목을 좀 끌어줘. 내가 조금 더 찾아볼게. 내가 갔: Draw their attention for me while I search a little more. I think there's something in the direction I explored, but it isn't easy to find.
Help me a little longer. Please.
strings.저는 이 섬에 대해 잘 모르니까, 지금은 그렇게 하는 게 좋을 것 같아요: I don't know this island well, so that sounds like the best approach for now.
Good. It's rare to find someone so easy to work with. This is a pleasure.
strings.그러면 빨리 다녀올게. 그럼 그때까지 방해하려는 놈들의 시선을 다른 곳으: I'll be quick. Until then, keep those troublemakers looking elsewhere.
strings.와아, 멀리서 보니 넌 정말 대단해. 그렇게 녀석들을 몰아놓고 따돌리다니: Wow. Watching from a distance, you're incredible. Herding them together and shaking them off like that... Oh, right. Do you know what I found?
strings.그래, 수상한 공간 하나를 발견했어. 그런데 수상하다 보다 끔찍한 것 같: Yes. A suspicious place. Though horrifying might be a better word than suspicious.
strings.그 안에는 수상한 괴물들이 있었고, 그 괴물들 일부가 밖으로 나오려고 하: There were strange monsters inside, and some seemed to be trying to get out.
strings.이곳에서는 볼 수 없는 생물, 아니 괴물이지. 그곳이 어쩌면 우리가 찾으: Creatures... no, monsters that don't belong here. That may be the place we've been looking for.
I'll go. I need to check it... There's something I want to know...
Be careful. It looked truly dangerous...
It's noisy outside... Someone seems to have arrived...
strings.제칼이 모은 리베라 정부군이 그럴 리는 없겠지? 굳이 소란을 일으킨 건: It can't be the Riverian government troops Zekal gathered, can it? They wouldn't deliberately make a scene.
strings.방해가 된다면 처리하는 게 좋지 않겠어?: If they're going to interfere, shouldn't we deal with them?
The noise keeps growing. Whoever it is, they're no novice.
strings.뭐, 잘 됐지. 여길 뜨기 전에 테스트를 한 번 해보자고. 우리들의 마석: Well, that's convenient. Let's run one more test before we leave. With our magic stones...
Haven't we already gathered all the data we need? We have more than enough compared with what he gave us.
That's settled. But there are still some uncertain aspects to the stones' brainwashing ability.
Anyway, let's watch that and then leave. It shouldn't take long.
strings.(알비스가 그 안을 확인하고 들어온 %s의 이야기를 듣고, 말을 잇지 못: (After hearing %s's account of what was found inside, Alvis is at a loss for words.)
strings.납치 당해서 영문도 모르고 생체 실험의 재료가 된 사람과 마석의 힘으로: People abducted and unknowingly used as materials for experiments on living bodies, and water spirits brainwashed by magic stones... Horrifying.
strings.제칼 시장과 시의회 녀석들, 분명 저곳의 존재를 알고 있었을 거야. 이건: Mayor Zekal and those council members must have known that place existed. This is truly...
We still need more information, but...
There's no way Riveria's mayor, who controls access to Merin Island, didn't know about that laboratory. He must be involved.
strings.시장은 대체 무슨 일을 꾸미고 있는 거지?: What on earth is the mayor planning?
strings.제칼 시장이 자꾸 이상한 일을 벌인다 생각했는데, 이건 선을 넘었어. 확: I thought Zekal kept doing strange things, but this crosses the line. No doubt about it. He's gone beyond that and meddled in things that should never be touched.
strings.%s, 돌아가서 혁명군과 널 보낸 사람에게 이 사실을 모두 전하라고. 나: %s, return and tell the revolutionaries and the person who sent you everything. I'll stay here and keep watch.
Then I'll head back. Be careful.
strings.마석 실험실이라니 믿을 수 없군요. 시에서 출입을 막고 있던 섬에서 이런: A magic stone laboratory... Unbelievable. If this was happening on an island whose access the city blocked, then surely...
Mayor Zekal knew. There are a few things we need to check first.
strings.어설프게 접근했다가는 오히려 당할 수 있으니까요.. 아무래도 모험가님이: If we approach carelessly, they could turn the tables on us. Since you visited the laboratory, they probably know about you already.
So we need more evidence. Something absolutely conclusive...
strings.그래야 아가슈라와 제칼 시장이 어떤 이유로 협력하고 있는지 알 수 있겠죠: Only then can we learn why the Agasura and Mayor Zekal are cooperating.
strings.일단 저는 리베라의 혁명군 공유하고 진행 방향을 논의하겠습니다. 그 동안: I'll share this with Riveria's revolutionaries and discuss how to proceed. Meanwhile, please gather information on Zekal.
strings.제칼이 상인 출신이어서 마르텔리 님께 물어보시면 될 것 같습니다. 오랫동: He used to be a merchant, so Martelli should be a good person to ask. He's run a trading company in Riveria for a long time.
strings.그리고 이 일이 끝나면 모험가님께서 원하시는 정보도 얻으실 수 있을 것입: And once this is over, you should be able to obtain the information you want too.
strings.너무 걱정하는 일 없었으면 합니다. 폐하께서도 약속을 지키기 위해서 노력: Please don't worry too much. Her Majesty is working to keep her promise as well.
The revolutionaries know of your achievements, so you can go without drawing attention.
strings.왔군, 기다리고 있었네. 제칼에 대해서 궁금한 게 있다고 했으니 알려주지: You're here. I've been waiting. I heard you had questions about Zekal, so I'll tell you what I know.
strings.그는 무능하고 탐욕스러운 최악의 인간일세. 그의 편을 드는 자가 없을 정: He's the worst kind of man: incompetent and greedy. Hardly anyone would take his side...
strings.그래, 그런 인물이라네. 하여튼, 이야기를 이어가겠네. 제칼은 대상인이라: Yes, that bad. Anyway, let me continue. Zekal was born into the family of a great merchant and grew up wanting for nothing.
Then he inherited the trading company, and before long, it all went bankrupt.
strings.귀도 얇고, 실력도 없는데 잘못된 선택도 많이 하면서 주위에 있던 사람들: He was easily swayed and had no ability. He made so many bad decisions that the people around him abandoned him.
And then a man like that suddenly became mayor.
strings.나조차도 의문이네. 무능으로 상단을 파산으로 이끌었던 자가 시장이 됐다는: Even I wonder. Nobody could believe that the man whose incompetence bankrupted a trading company had become mayor.
People were suspicious of Zekal. At some point, his behavior changed completely.
strings.갑자기 그런거라면 뭔가 있지 않았을까요?: If it happened so suddenly, there must have been something behind it.
strings.일단 듣고 생각해보게. 상단을 다시 꾸리더니 엄청난 돈을 모으기 시작했지: Hear me out first. He rebuilt his trading company and began amassing enormous wealth. People gathered around him, and he built a powerful faction.
strings.시의회에 많은 돈을 냈고, 시장 선거에 출마해서 결국 당선까지 됐네. 많: He gave large sums to the city council, ran for mayor, and was elected. Many opposed him, but the council pushed him through.
strings.그리고 리베라에 많은 군사를 모으기 시작했네. 왕을 꿈꾸는 것처럼 독재를: Then he began gathering troops in Riveria. He chose dictatorship, as if dreaming of becoming a king.
strings.덕분에 지금의 리베라는 엉망이 되어버렸어. 적어도 그가 시장이 되기 전까: Thanks to him, Riveria is a complete mess now. It may have had problems before he became mayor, but never this bad.
There are far too many suspicious details.
strings.게다가 언젠가부터 디트라는 집사가 붙어있었네. 출신을 알 수 없는 수상한: Also, at some point, a butler named Dit appeared at his side. A suspicious man of unknown origins. Zekal's actions sometimes changed according to his advice.
strings.내가 알고 있는 건 다 말해줬네. 우리도 우리대로 열심히 상황을 극복하고: That's everything I know. We're doing all we can to overcome the situation too...
So please do your best. I'll trust you.
strings.마르텔리 님께서 말씀하신 대로입니다. 사람이 갑자기 변하면 뭔가 있어야: Just as Martelli said, there must be a reason for such a sudden change. For now, let's assume that reason was a contract with an Agasura.
I don't know much about it, but I hear an Agasura's contract grants wishes.
Yes, though I don't know the limits of what it can grant...
strings.제칼 시장의 변화와 메린 섬에서 발견된 마석 실험실. 그리고 왕을 꿈꾸는: Mayor Zekal's transformation, the magic stone laboratory on Merin Island, and a man dreaming of kingship... But do Agasura really have enough power to change a person so completely?
I don't think that alone explains it.
The magic stones must have something to do with it.
If we could discover why they created the stones, I think we'd have our answer...
strings.(뭔가 더 알 수 있는게 있으면 좋겠어….): (I wish there were something more I could learn...)
Adventurer, let me introduce Eva, leader of the Revolutionary Army.
I think it would be best to discuss this together.
So this is the adventurer Levi mentioned... I've heard much about you.
Thanks to your efforts, the Revolutionary Army has been able to approach the truth.
The connection between the magic stone laboratory, the Agasura, and Mayor Zekal...
It was deeply frustrating that we couldn't even uncover that.
strings.하지만, 이제 모험가님 덕분에 저희가 움직일 수 있게 됐습니다. 그동안: But thanks to you, we can act now. We've been able to gather our revolutionary forces in the meantime.
Thank you. At this moment, that's all I can say...
strings.그러면 이제 어떻게 하실 거죠? 제 의견을 말씀드려도 될까요?: Then what will you do now? May I offer a suggestion?
strings.시장 관사에 자료가 있을 것 같은데, 잠입해서 증거 자료를 찾는 건 어떨: There may be documents in the mayor's residence. How about infiltrating it and looking for evidence?
Yes. That is clearly the best course... but our Revolutionary Army has no one with those skills.
strings.%s 님은 많은 일들을 해결하신 경험이 있으십니다. 저희 폐하께서도 믿고: %s has experience resolving many difficult situations. Even Her Majesty trusts this adventurer.
Of course, I've witnessed those achievements too, so I trust them as well. An excellent person...
Thank you for the praise. Then I'll do it.
strings.다시 한번 감사드립니다. 모든 걸 모험가님께 부탁드리는 것 죄송할 따름이: Thank you once again. I'm sorry to ask you to handle everything...
Meanwhile, we'll support you from the rear and make sure nothing else goes wrong.
Please make sure to collect useful evidence from city hall.
Haha. I never expected to be defeated like this. You're skilled in combat.
Ugh, that was close. What exactly are you...?
strings.시장 제칼님을 보좌하고 있는 집사입니다. 시장님이 직접 상대하시는 것보단: I'm the butler who assists Mayor Zekal. I thought it would be better for me to face you than for the mayor to do so himself.
strings.혹시 너도 그런 건가?: Are you one of those too?
How foolish of you to compare me to that stupid ogre.
strings.이런, 제가 실언을 했네요. 그렇다면 그 멍청한 오우거를 어떻게 했는지: Oh dear, a slip of the tongue. In that case, I think I know what happened to that foolish ogre.
You're the one who ruined my master's plans. Hehe. How interesting.
What are you planning? Answer me...
Hehe. Thanks to you, I've bought some time.
strings.아무래도 지금 제가 끼어들기는 애매하니 물러나야겠군요. 그럼 다음에 뵙죠: It would be awkward for me to intervene now, so I should withdraw. Until next time. Assuming you're still alive by then...
strings.(말이 끝나기 무섭게 디트가 흔적도 없이 사라져버린다.): (Before the words have fully left his mouth, Dit disappears without a trace.)
strings.뭐야, 뭐야? 어디로 간거야?: What? What? Where did he go?
strings.침입자가 정말 한 명이었단 말이냐?: There really was only one intruder?
strings.내가, 내가 그렇게 애를 써서 만들었던 군대가 모두 전멸했다고?: The army I worked so hard to build has been completely wiped out?
strings.으으, 감히 날 방해하다니 가만두지 않겠다. 그건 그렇고 어떻게 그분께: Grr... You dare interfere with me? I won't let you get away with this. More importantly, how am I going to explain this to him...?
Still no end to your excuses, Mayor.
strings.집사, 네 놈!! 왜 이제야 나타나는 것이냐?: Butler! You wretch!! Why are you only showing up now?
strings.(분명 저 집사도 뭔가 있어.): (There's definitely something about that butler too.)
It was entertaining to watch you, adventurer.
strings.지금은 제가 직접 싸우러 온게 아니라 볼 일만 보고 돌아가겠습니다. 하하: I'm not here to fight you personally this time. I'll simply take care of my business and leave. Haha.
Mayor Zekal. Thank you for your efforts.
strings.수고는 저희가 더 많이 했죠. 무능력한 바보를 시장으로 만들어 놓느라 주: Though we did far more work. You have no idea how much trouble my master and I went through to make an incompetent fool into a mayor.
It greatly benefited the master who took me in.
strings.그리고 다음 명을 받들겠습니다. 이용 가치가 끝난 물건을 폐기하라는 명령: And now I'll carry out my next order. I've been instructed to dispose of an object that has outlived its usefulness.
strings.폐, 폐기? 설마 그건 나를 이야기하는 거냐?: D-dispose? Surely you don't mean me?
strings.나를? 이제 와서 나를? 나를 폐기하겠다고? 내가 그동안 너희들을 위해: Me? After all this? You intend to dispose of me? After everything I've done for you!!
strings.평소에도 말을 섞고 싶지 않았었는데, 역시 이번에도 천박하게 말씀을 하시: I never enjoyed speaking with you, and once again you speak so vulgarly. Let's end this, Mayor Zekal.
strings.그러면 그분을 위해서 실컷 날뛰어 주십쇼. 인간임을 망각한 채로, 욕망의: Now, rampage to your heart's content for him. Forget that you're human, and show us the true depths of your desire.
Heh... Damn you, Ban... Urgh! What have you done to me...?
strings.이런식으로 나를… 쿨럭! 쿨럭!: And you treat me like this... Cough! Cough!
Hehehe... An Agasura. Heh... Yes. I should never have trusted an Agasura.
An Agasura that remains unharmed even after granting a wish...
strings.(더는 제칼에게서 어떤 말도 들을 수 없을 것 같다.): (It seems Zekal can no longer say anything.)
An Agasura... So an Agasura was controlling people like that...
I don't understand... I just don't understand...
I've never seen an Agasura cause trouble on this scale...
...Let's go back for now. I should return and sort out my thoughts...
strings.(에바가 시청에서 있었던 일을 듣고 놀란다.): (Eva is shocked to hear what happened at city hall.)
Mayor Zekal suddenly turned into a monster, so I had no choice but to fight.
strings.괜찮습니다. 제칼이 그렇게 된 것에 좀 놀라긴 했지만, 의외로 일이 쉽게: It's all right. I was surprised by what happened to him, but I'm glad the matter was resolved more easily than expected.
So the stories about your abilities were true.
Oh, I'm sorry. I made a mistake along the way and was discovered.
I should have been more careful...
I heard a story about you among the investigators.
strings.모험가님이 지나간 자리에 적을 찾을 수 없을 정도로 엄청나게 강하신 분이: They say you're so strong that no enemies can be found anywhere you've passed through...
That sounds like an exaggerated rumor...
strings.뭐, 좋은 게 좋은 거 아니겠습니까?: Well, isn't a good outcome what matters?
When you put it that way, I'll take it as a compliment.
Then let me explain what we've established.
Zekal has fallen, and we were able to find ledgers and records inside city hall.
strings.이 정도면 혁명군…, 아니 이제 리베라를 위해서 고생한 분들에게 도움이: That should be useful to the Revolutionary Army... no, to the people who've worked so hard for Riveria.
Thank you for all your efforts on our behalf...
strings.비록 이해관계가 통해 도와주신 것이라 하더라도 도움을 주신 것에 대해선: Even if you helped because our interests aligned, we will never forget what you've done.
strings.그리고 이걸 바탕으로 다시 살기 좋은 리베라가 될 수 있도록 힘쓰겠습니다: And we'll use this opportunity to make Riveria a good place to live again.
Once more, my sincere thanks to you and to the Jiendia Empire for your help.
strings.언제나 느끼는 거지만 사건이 끝나도 여전히 해야 할 일이 많은 것 같습니: I always feel this way, but even after an incident ends, there is still so much to do.
strings.모험가님, 자, 이 이야기는 여기서 마무리 짓도록 할까요?: Adventurer, shall we bring this matter to a close here?
Please spare me a moment. There's something I need to tell you.
strings.무슨 이야기인가 하면…. 마석 실험실, 그곳에 대한 이야기를 하려고 합니: It concerns the magic stone laboratory.
strings.알비스라는 분께서 마석 실험실에서 수상한 자들, 그러니까 저희가 알고 있: Alvis discovered traces of suspicious people there, the ones we believe are the Agasura we're after.
strings.모험가님께서 물의 정령과 전투를 벌이셨다는 그 장소…. 그 근처에 숨겨진: Near the place where you fought the water spirit... they found a hidden room.
Apparently, all sorts of experiments and research were conducted inside. It was truly horrifying.
We intend to collect the traces left there and pursue them... No, we're already pursuing them.
strings.신속, 정확! 그것이 바로 제국 조사단의 신념이지요. 후후!: Speed and accuracy! That's the creed of the imperial investigation team. Hehe!
Hearing that makes me look forward to what comes next.
Of course. You should look forward to it.
Oh, Rosia is looking for you.
I don't know what it's about either. You'll find out when you see her.
I'll keep contacting you as soon as we have new information.
Until then, you should attend to other matters.
strings.(어쩔 수 없지 일단 기다려볼까?): (No helping it. I suppose I'll wait for now.)
I'll give you information about the person you're looking for.
strings.레비 씨가 먼저 우리에게 그분을 아느냐 물었어요. 모험가님께서 그분의 행: Levi first asked us whether we knew her. He said you were searching for her whereabouts...
strings.제가 직접 말씀드리고 싶었어요. 이리스라는 이름의 소녀, 리베라에 온 적: I wanted to tell you personally. A girl named Iris did come to Riveria. Only briefly...
Please listen calmly. She said she'd been trapped somewhere.
strings.아무것도 없는 슬픔만 가득한 공간, 그래서 서둘러 나오고 싶었는데, 나올: A place with nothing in it but sorrow. She wanted to leave quickly, but couldn't. Then, by chance, she found a way out...
strings.리베라 근처에서 정신을 차릴 수 있었대요. 그게 어떤 말인지 저같은 사람: She said she came to her senses near Riveria. Someone like me can't understand exactly what she meant...
strings.그래도 이리스라는 아이가 겪은 일을 나중에 알게 됐을 때 고생을 많이 했: But when I later learned what Iris had been through, I realized how much she'd suffered.
strings.저, 저기 그래서 이리스는 어디로 간 건가요?: Um, then where did Iris go?
So much time has passed already.
It's been a year since Iris left.
strings.이리스는 세레스 님이 계신 곳으로 가야 한다고 버릇처럼 말했죠. 하지만,: She would often say she had to go where Lady Seres was. But she hesitated, saying it wasn't time yet.
strings.전설에 따르면 여신께서 세계를 지키기 위해서 사라지셨다고 들었는데…. 흠: According to legend, the goddess vanished to protect the world... Hmm. Perhaps Iris went there to pray?
strings.프레이오스 남쪽에 오래된 신전이 있어요. 고대신 세레스 님을 믿는 교단이: There's an old temple in southern Freios. A temple belonging to the order that worships the ancient goddess Seres... Perhaps she went there.
strings.고맙습니다, 로지아. 정말 도움이 됐어요: Thank you, Rosia. You've been a great help.
strings.세레스 님은…. 언젠가 내게 말씀하셨는데…. 분명…. 그때 무슨 말씀을: Lady Seres... She spoke to me once... I'm sure... What did she say then? My memory...
strings.잘 모르겠어. 하지만, 그래도 여기서 이럴 수는 없어. 일단, 신전으로: I can't remember. But I can't stay here like this. Let's go to the temple first. I'll find out when I get there, won't I?
Wait for me, Iris... I'll find you.
